observations.body: Visions, paradise, a thorn, and strength in weakness. It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord. Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 12:1–10 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states visions, paradise, a thorn, and strength in weakness. It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord. Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
